name: Dust trail: no restart during power-up, new power-up afterwards
expected: Ticks 3-4: dust is detected again but the power-up is not restarted: no Clean write, counter keeps counting (C14).
Tick 5: power-up ends: Clean = clean_on, even though dust is detected on that tick (C28).
Tick 6: dust at (5,4) on a later tick: a NEW power-up starts, Clean = clean_up (C28).
Tick 9: Clean = clean_on. Tick 10: wall at (9,4): Turn Left + clean_off.
function_text: EF-12 – Dust: power-up (clean_up) for 3 ticks, then back to clean_on
EF-13 – Dust during an active power-up does not restart it; dust after the end starts a new one
EF-04 – Periodic left/right/dust sampling, once per tick
EF-17 – Direction and Clean are sent only when their value changes; signals only on transitions
